description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) ADVANCED STABILISERS (Grav-Assault Force, 1 CP) — WP-C5. A real click on Use spends 1 CP: its ranged weapons count as [ASSAULT]; it shoots the Gretchin with its accelerator cannon.
